title: Watch Out, We're Mad
writer: Marcello Fondato, Francesco Scardamaglia, Vicente Coello
actors: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, John Sharp
plot: After a tied first place in a local stunt race, two drivers start a contest to decide which of them will own the prize, a dune buggy. But when a mobster destroys the car, they are determined to get it back.
